scope: Explicit current profile-document selections for validation routes with several stage-ready historical revisions. A selection only resolves which static profile to test. It does not prove deployment, binding, behavior, visual quality, gameplay, or acceptance.
limits: Selections are explicit route inputs and must match a stage-ready profile document byte-for-byte.
Historical alternatives remain visible in stage readiness and are not deleted, merged, or relabeled.
Changing a selection requires regenerating stage readiness before a live route plan is valid.
